hand_read.summary: Waddle Dee. Walks, sometimes jumps (random, and at walls), turns at walls / ledges. Never targets anyone and has no contact hitbox: only its defeated body (bullet) and its dropped parasol hurt. Parasol variations float down slowly with the parasol open.
hand_read.variations: var 0 / 1 carry a parasol (fall with ParasolFall through the EnemyAerialModule; the parasol meshes follow lr; when hit / killed the parasol is dropped as the article 'waddledee_parasol' and var becomes var + 2); var 2 / 3 have none. Ledge turning: var 1 and 3 only (0 and 2 walk off).

states.1: Fall: kinetic 8, attach off, Fall (loop). On ground -> 3 (interrupt).
states.2: Parasol fall (var 0/1): EnemyAerialModule set_mode_normal(accel P0.f6 0.0005, max 10, 10), current speed (x kept, y = -P0.f5 0.2), ParasolFall (loop); aerial update with stick lr each frame. On ground -> 3.
states.4: Walk: kinetic 1, attach on, Walk (loop) at rate PS78.f3 = 1.2 (struct at +0x78: 100 50 50 1.2). Update move(lr). Every PS78.f0 = 100 frames: random_range(1,100) <= PS78.f1 = 50 -> 6 (jump). Wall: random_range(1,100) > PS78.f2 = 50 -> 5 (turn) else -> 6 (jump). var 1/3: ledge -> 5. Off ground -> 1 (var 2/3) or 2 (var 0/1).
states.5: Turn: kinetic 0, Turn. Motion end -> reverse_lr -> 4 (interrupt).
states.6: Jump: kinetic 5, attach off, Jump. Vertical speed <= 0 -> 1 / 2.
states.7: Death flight (death_state 7): Damage at rate 0, bullet(); ATTACK ARMED (P2 entry 0); damage face shown. Flag 8 -> 8.

danger.states: parasol dropped (var 0/1 when hit or killed: slots 13, 69, 71 -> L5cf90 generate_article(0))
danger.note: article attack fields id 0, part 0, node 2001 (inferred: the weapon's own node)

hand_read.targeting: none (no search calls): it faces the nearest fighter only at start.
hand_read.projectiles: article 0 = weapon kind 0xB0-range id from enemy_article_data_set_waddledee: the parasol (dropped, not shot).
hand_read.death: HP 0 -> 7 (bullet, damage face) -> 8 remove; the parasol is dropped first (notify_on_death -> L5cf90).
hand_read.meshes: vmt: 0 Cparasol, 1 Larm, 2 Lparasol, 3 Rarm, 4 Rparasol, 5 damage, 6 normal. L5d04c (every state enter): var 2/3 (no parasol): Larm/Rarm on, parasols off, normal face (damage off). var 0/1: Cparasol on while ParasolFall (motion 11) and both arms off; otherwise the parasol in the hand on the side given by lr (Lparasol + Rarm, or Rparasol + Larm) and node scale squash (slots 21 / 55). Death (L5cf18): both arms, no parasol, damage face on, normal off.
